upstream.title: fix: wait for all legacy research sections
upstream.body:
## Summary
- persist the planned sections before dispatching parallel research workers
- wait for every planned worker to return before prompting the supervisor to write final sections
- add offline regression coverage for dispatch, partial completion, and full completion

Fixes #284

## Testing
- `uv run pytest tests/test_legacy_multi_agent.py -q`
- `uv run ruff check tests/test_legacy_multi_agent.py`
- `uv run ruff format --check tests/test_legacy_multi_agent.py`
